row: Dr Mohamed Alaa | Pets, Wildlife & Farm

Welcome to Dr. Mohamed Alaa Vet, a professional veterinary channel dedicated to animal health, treatment, and awareness.

I’m Dr. Mohamed Alaa, a licensed veterinarian providing trusted, practical, and science-based veterinary knowledge for:

🐶 Pets (dogs & cats)

🐄 Farm animals & ruminants

🦁 Wildlife & exotic animals

On this channel, you will find:

Accurate diagnosis & treatment explanations

Medication dosages (veterinary & human drugs used safely in animals)

Disease prevention & animal care tips

Real clinical cases explained simply

Educational content for veterinarians & animal owners

🎯 My mission is to make veterinary medicine simple, reliable, and accessible for everyone — from pet owners to veterinary professionals.

📍 Based in Egypt – Content relevant to the Middle East & Africa

Subscribe and join a community that truly cares about animal health.
